entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Mark. Pulling that up now... I see the order for the VeloPro cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work. I want my money back.
I'm sorry to hear that. When you say they don't work, do you mean there's a technical fault, like with the boa dials or the mounting for the cleats, or is it more of a fit and preference issue?
I rode in them twice and got horrible blisters. They're useless to me.
Oh, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Getting blisters is awful. Let me check the policy for you. I see the delivery date was 31 days ago.
Right. So are you going to do this or not?

Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.
Fine. Whatever. Just send the label.

Of course. I've just initiated that for you. You should see the email with the return label in your inbox within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's everything on my end. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope we can provide you with a better experience in the future. Have a good day.
